title: It's The Margins That Matter
description_clean: OPINION: It appears to be difficult for people who haven’t tried to run a business to understand the difference between assets and cash. Nor do they understand that record payouts and schedules aren’t the same thing as record profits – it is the margins that matter. Or that the risk in farming is such that interest rates are higher than for housing, and that if something goes wrong, it is the house as well as the business that might be lost. Farmers and growers understand all these factors, but somehow the message is not getting through to society in general and some groups in particular. Econ
summary: An opinion piece argues that many people misunderstand the difference between assets and cash in farming, and that record payouts do not equal record profits—margins are what matter, along with the elevated financial risks farmers face.
